רמד.ja: אלאנסאן ותיקנהא וג'עלהא קואעד לטאעתה ואצולא לעמלה תם אכ'לאצה ללה תעאלי פיהא, ולם ילתפת אלי סואה, ולא אמל גירה, ולא קצד בהא גיר רצ'אה.
רמד.en: of the human, and verified, and made foundations for his obedience and roots for his action, then his purification for God (exalted be He) in them is completed; he turns to no other than Him, hopes in none but Him, and aims by them at none but His satisfaction.

pairs.en: of the human, and verified
and made foundations for his obedience
and roots for his action
then his purification for God (exalted be He) in them is completed
he turns to no other than Him
hopes in none but Him
and aims by them at none but His satisfaction

רמד.ja: אולהא אכ'לאץ אלתוחיד ללה תעאלי עלי מא תקדם פי אוול כתאבי הד'א.
רמד.en: **The first** — purification of the affirmation of God's unity (exalted be He), as has gone before in the opening of this book of mine.

pairs.en: **The first**
purification of the affirmation of God's unity (exalted be He)

pairs.ja: עלי מא תקדם פי אוול כתאבי הד'א
pairs.en: as has gone before in the opening of this book of mine

רמד.ja: ואלת'אני אעתבאר נעם אללה עליה ותואתרהא לדיה עלי מא שרחנא פיה איצ'א.
רמד.en: **The second** — reflection on God's blessings upon him and their succession to him, as we have explicated there also.

pairs.en: **The second**
reflection on God's blessings upon him and their succession
as we have explicated there also

רמד.ja: ואלת'אלת' אלתזאם אלטאעה ללה עלי מא ד'כרת פיה איצ'א.
רמד.en: **The third** — binding-oneself to obedience to God, as I have mentioned there also.

pairs.en: **The third**
binding-oneself to obedience to God
as I have mentioned there also

רמד.ja: ואלראבע אפראדה באלתוכל עליה דון אלמכ'לוקין.
רמד.en: **The fourth** — singling Him out by reliance to the exclusion of created beings.

pairs.en: **The fourth**
singling Him out by reliance
to the exclusion of created beings

רמד.ja: ואלכ'אמס צחהֵ יקינה באן אלנפע ואלצ'ר לא אלי ראי מכ'לוק ולא פי קדרתה דון אד'ן אלכ'אלק תעאלי.
רמד.en: **The fifth** — the soundness of his certainty that benefit and harm are not in the discretion of any created being nor in his power, apart from the permission of the Creator (exalted be He).

pairs.en: **The fifth**
the soundness of his certainty
that benefit and harm

pairs.ja: לא אלי ראי מכ'לוק ולא פי קדרתה
pairs.en: are not in the discretion of any created being nor in his power
apart from the permission of the Creator (exalted be He)

רמד.ja: ואלסאדס אסתוי אלמדח ואלד'ם ענדה מן אלנאס לה.
רמד.en: **The sixth** — that praise and blame from people toward him be equal in his eyes.

pairs.en: **The sixth**

pairs.ja: אסתוי אלמדח ואלד'ם ענדה מן אלנאס
pairs.en: that praise and blame from people toward him be equal in his eyes

רמד.en: **The seventh** — the abandoning of self-adornment for people.

pairs.en: **The seventh**
the abandoning of self-adornment for people

רמד.ja: ואלת'אמן אכ'לא באלה וקלבה מן אשגאל אלדניא ענד עמלה ללאכ'רה.
רמד.en: **The eighth** — emptying his mind and his heart of the preoccupations of this world at the time of his work for the next world.

pairs.en: **The eighth**
emptying his mind and his heart
of the preoccupations of this world
at the time of his work for the next world

רמד.ja: ואלתאסע מראקבהֵ אללה ג'ל ועז ואלחיא מנה.
רמד.en: **The ninth** — watchful awareness of God (mighty and exalted) and shame before Him.

pairs.en: **The ninth**
watchful awareness of God (mighty and exalted)
and shame before Him

רמד.ja: ואלעאשר משורהֵ אלעקל פי כל מא יוסוס אלהוי פי קלבה ואלאכ'ד' בראיה דון ראי אלהוי.
רמד.en: **The tenth** — taking counsel of the intellect in everything that caprice whispers in his heart, and acting on its judgment to the exclusion of the judgment of caprice.

pairs.en: **The tenth**
taking counsel of the intellect

pairs.ja: פי כל מא יוסוס אלהוי פי קלבה
pairs.en: in everything that caprice whispers in his heart
and acting on its judgment to the exclusion of the judgment of caprice

רמד.ja: ואמא אלאעמאל אלתי תכמל באלאכ'לאץ ללה ענד תנאולהא פהי אעמאל אלטאעה אלמבתגי בהא רצ'א אללה תעאלי, והי ג'מלהֵ אלפראיץ' אלט'אהרה עלי אלג'וארח אלתי ימכן פיהא תוג'יההא לגיר אללה פיכון קצד פאעלהא אלתזיין ללנאס בהא ואבתגא כראמתהם לה וחמדהם איאה עלי עמלהא.
רמד.en: As for the works that are completed by the purification for God when one undertakes them — they are the works of obedience aimed at the satisfaction of God (exalted be He): namely, the totality of the manifest obligations upon the limbs, in which the doer's directing of them to other than God is possible, so that his aim becomes self-adornment for people by them, the seeking of their honor for him, and their praise of him for performing them.

pairs.ja: ואמא אלאעמאל אלתי תכמל באלאכ'לאץ ללה
pairs.en: As for the works that are completed by the purification for God
when one undertakes them
they are the works of obedience
aimed at the satisfaction of God (exalted be He)

pairs.ja: והי ג'מלהֵ אלפראיץ' אלט'אהרה עלי אלג'וארח
pairs.en: namely, the totality of the manifest obligations upon the limbs

pairs.ja: אלתי ימכן פיהא תוג'יההא לגיר אללה
pairs.en: in which the doer's directing of them to other than God is possible

רמד.ja: ואמא פראיץ' אלקלוב פלא ימכן פיהא ריא ולא חב אלכראמה ואלת'נא למן אלתזם שיא מנהא, אד' לא עלם ללנאס בד'לך מנה, ואנמא יקצד בהא צאחבהא וג'ה אלמטלע עליה והו
רמד.en: As for the duties of the heart — neither ostentation nor love of honor and praise is possible in them for whoever has bound himself to anything of them, since people have no knowledge of that from him; the one who undertakes them aims by them at the face of the One who is informed of them, namely

pairs.en: As for the duties of the heart
neither ostentation
nor love of honor and praise is possible in them

pairs.ja: אד' לא עלם ללנאס בד'לך מנה
pairs.en: since people have no knowledge of that from him
the one who undertakes them aims by them
at the face of the One who is informed of them
namely
